tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Core registry profile of a Lithuanian legal entity: name, legal form, status, registered address, registration dates, capital, activities and current management. Real-time from the state register.

tools.name: get_participants
tools.description: Current participants (shareholders, members) of a Lithuanian legal entity.

tools.name: get_beneficial_owners
tools.description: Declared beneficial owners of a Lithuanian legal entity, with ownership percentages and control basis. Served under the legitimate-interest regime; a purpose is required and is logged.

tools.name: get_real_estate
tools.description: Real property registered to a Lithuanian legal entity, with the rights recorded on each object. Legal entities only.

tools.name: get_seizures
tools.description: Property seizure acts registered against a Lithuanian legal entity, with the institution that imposed them, the parties and the seized assets. An entity with no acts is a clean record, not a missing answer.

tools.name: get_court_cases
tools.description: Court hearings where the Lithuanian legal entity appears as a party.

tools.name: get_due_diligence_report
tools.description: One call returning the whole picture: profile, participants, beneficial owners, real property, seizure acts and court cases. Cheaper than the parts bought separately. A purpose is required because the report contains beneficial-owner data.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_company" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
